name: workbench-collapse-reset
title: 收起 Workbench 时重置为视频列表空态并隐藏输入法
creator: M0e_N00b
notes: DONE 2026-10-02 in 50a3f01 (build-windows-debug.ps1 BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 172 unit tests). Root cause verified, and it was NOT a missing reset: ViriViriAppState.openWorkbenchEmpty() already resets route + isKeyboardVisible + isKeyboardDismissed + isCandidatesExpanded, but it was only called from applyPlaybackCanvasSlots(), guarded by `BROWSE !in slots && TRANSPORT in slots && selected != null`. A dismissal dispatches PlaybackCanvasEvent.Dismiss, moving the canvas to QUIET_WATCH, whose visible slots are MEDIA_STAGE only (PlaybackCanvasContracts.kt:77, asserted at PlaybackCanvasContractsTest.kt:111) -- so the guard can never hold after a dismissal and the reset was deferred to the next summon, which is the route switch the user saw on open. Fix: call openWorkbenchEmpty() from dismissWorkbenchFromCenterContent() at dismissal time, keeping the applyPlaybackCanvasSlots call for the summon-time path. The `selected != null` gate is DELIBERATE and must not be relaxed: with no video there is no list to fall back to, so the route must be left untouched (confirmed with the user 2026-10-02). No unit test added on purpose: the changed path is Activity code plus a Context-bound app-state method, and the project has no Robolectric (testImplementation is junit only). STILL OPEN (device): confirm the centre route returns to the empty list immediately on collapse with the input method gone, and that collapsing without a selected video leaves the route alone.
